newsitem.title: ITALY: Finmeccanica sees Q1 1997 sales rise.
newsitem.headline: Finmeccanica sees Q1 1997 sales rise.

text.p: Italian state-controlled defence and engineering group Finmeccanica said on Wednesday that its sales in the first quarter of 1997 rose to 2.742 trillion lire from 2.600 trillion lire in the first quarter of 1996.

The group's managing director Bruno Steve told the group's shareholders meeting that a seven-year rolling three trillion lire loan the group secured on Tuesday converting short term debt into long term debt would help trim the interest it pays on its debts by 1.5 percentage points.
